settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.body: Details for this mask are on the product itself. As a rule: silk is washed cold by hand or on a gentle cycle in a bag, dried flat and away from sun. Do not wring it and do not tumble dry it. Elastic lasts longer if you do not stretch it over a doorknob.

settings.heading: Fit
settings.body: The strap adjusts, and it is covered along its whole length so it does not catch in hair or leave a mark. If it sits low on the nose, loosen it by a centimetre rather than tightening it: the seal comes from the shape, not the tension.

settings.heading: Delivery
settings.body: Free shipping Australia wide, sent tracked with Australia Post. Express is available at checkout. Order before the cut-off on a business day and it is packed that afternoon.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.body: Unopened, 30 days, return postage on us. Anything faulty is replaced whatever the timeframe. Nothing in this policy limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
